transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. I'm Dr. [Your Name]. What brings you in today? How can I help you?

Hi. Well, I came in because I've started doing things at work and school that just... they don't really make sense. I work as a bookkeeping clerk, and lately I've been doing stuff like lining receipts all the way across the floor. Or I'll sit at my desk and just tap the calculator in sets of nine. 

The other day, I was just standing by the copier with my hands held up in the air, and I just stayed like that until someone came over and asked if I was okay. I'm not really sure why I'm doing these things, so I figured I needed to come in and talk to someone about it.
Have you ever felt like you're seeing or hearing things that others don't, or have you had thoughts that seem unusual or hard to explain?

Yeah, actually. Um, sometimes when I'm alone at my desk, or when I'm walking home from class, I'll hear a voice. It's a man's voice, and he says things to me. He'll tell me to check line seven, or he'll say that I missed the sign. It sounds so real and clear that I actually stop and look around to see who's talking to me, but... there's never anyone there.
Have you ever had thoughts or beliefs that other people don't seem to understand, or that you feel strongly about even when others tell you they aren't true?

Yeah, actually. Um, I know it sounds strange, but I get convinced that certain invoice totals, or account numbers and due dates at work, are actually messages about me. 

My supervisor has noticed me getting stuck on them, and he'll actually sit down and show me that they're just normal entries for the clients. But even when he proves it and I see the math, I still feel like... I just feel like they are tracking whether I understand the pattern.
Do you believe, despite what others may say, that these messages you're seeing in the numbers mean something specific about you or your actions?

Yeah, exactly like I was just saying. It's hard to explain, but... yes, I do. Even after my supervisor sits down and proves to me that the invoice totals and account numbers are completely normal, I still believe it. I just can't shake the feeling that they are actual messages directed at me. No matter what anyone else says or shows me, I really do feel like they're tracking me to see if I understand the pattern.
Have you ever felt like your thoughts are being controlled by someone else, or that thoughts are being put into your mind that aren't your own?
No, I haven't ever felt like that. Um, my thoughts always feel like my own. I've never had the feeling that someone else was controlling them or putting things in my head.
Do you ever feel like things that are happening around you, like events or people’s actions, are specifically directed at you or have a special meaning just for you?

Yeah, that's pretty much exactly what I was trying to say about the invoices. Like I mentioned, I get convinced that those specific account numbers and due dates at work have a special meaning just for me. It feels like they are messages, and even when my supervisor shows me they're just normal work entries, I still get that feeling that they're tracking whether I understand the pattern. So, yeah, I do feel like things have a special meaning directed at me.
Are there times when you believe something strongly, even though there's clear proof against it, and does this belief stay with you even after the proof is gone?

Yeah, that's exactly what happens with the work stuff I was just talking about. I know it sounds strange, but I get so convinced that certain invoice totals, account numbers, and due dates are messages about me. And even when there is clear proof against it—like when my supervisor literally sits down and shows me on the screen that they are just normal, everyday entries—the feeling doesn't go away. I still feel like they are tracking whether I understand the pattern, even after he proves it's all normal.

Have you ever had beliefs that something bizarre was happening—like something out of a science fiction movie—or that people were working together in secret against you or controlling your actions in some way?

No, nothing like that. I don't think anything like a sci-fi movie is happening, and I don't feel like people are secretly plotting against me or controlling me. It's really just the thing with the numbers at work that I mentioned.
Have you ever had these kinds of strong, unshakable beliefs about other things besides the numbers at work, or is this the only area where you feel this way?

No, honestly, it's just the numbers at work. I haven't noticed anything like that happening anywhere else in my life. It's really just the invoices and account numbers that give me that feeling. Outside of the office, everything seems pretty normal to me.
